messages:
maria: Ok team — quick follow-up from last night's pager spam (INV-237). We were lucky but there were a few handoff gaps that made mitigation slower. I'd like to set up 1:1 shadow sessions for new on-callers + a brief group runthrough of the incident runbook. Who can pair this week?

oncall-bot: [ALERT] 2024-11-02 02:13 UTC - INV-237: inference-prod p95/p99 latency spike. Pages sent to @maria @ben @kevin. Incident created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INV-237 :rotating_light:

ben: I can do a 60m shadow session Thu 9am PT. I was primary on the first page — I can walk through the mitigation timeline and the quick kv-cache rollback we used.

kevin: Thu morning works for me too but would prefer afternoon if someone needs east-coast times. Also want to flag that the runbook step for "force-fallback-to-small-model" was ambiguous — we accidentally routed to a non-compatible quantized variant. Recommend we add a compatibility checklist.

olivia: +1 for adding compatibility checklist. I can take lead on updating the runbook doc if someone provides the exact commands they ran.

natalie: I'm new to on-call (just finished orientation) and would like to shadow. My availability: Wed 1-4pm PT, Thu 8-11am PT. Also, can someone show me how to read the latency-summaries dashboard during a page?

maria: Great — tentative plan: Thu 9am PT session with Ben (primary recount + timeline), Kevin (model routing & fallback details), Olivia (runbook edits). Natalie you'll shadow that session. If anyone else wants to join, ping here. We'll record and drop notes in the handbook.

ben: I'll prepare a short deck: timeline, what the alert looks like in Grafana, the quick mitigation commands we ran (I'll paste them in the channel). Also will include the customer-impact blurb we used for comms: "Transient increased latency for inference-prod affected a small subset of customers between 02:10-02:50 UTC; requests were retried automatically and overall error rate stayed below 0.5%."

kevin: Here's the safe rollback snippet I used (test on staging first):
```
# rollback model routing to baseline
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/rollback \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"inference-prod","to_model":"gptx-small-v1"}'
```
Note: the token above requires `ops:routes` permission. Add to runbook.

olivia: I'll add a pre-check section to the runbook: model ABI compatibility, quantization flags, and a small checklist for canary traffic verification. Will link PR here before Thu.

maria: For the actual shadowing mechanics: primary = handles pages first, secondary = triage and escalate, shadow = observer and notes. Suggested pairing flow: 1) Primary announces intention in channel; 2) Shadow watches dashboards + terminal; 3) Secondary stands by to take over if primary needs break; 4) Post-incident writeup within 4 hours. Thoughts?

natalie: That flow is perfect. Quick question: during a page, should the shadow ever acknowledge pages or stay silent? I want to follow proper etiquette.

ben: Shadow should not acknowledge pages unless primary explicitly asks for help. Main job is to observe, take notes, and learn the runbook steps. If you need clarification, DM the primary.

maria: Good rule. Also adding an onboarding checklist item: "first 2 shifts shadowed with primary on pager coverage" — we'll make it mandatory for new on-callers.

deploy-bot: FYI: There's a scheduled infra deploy Fri 02:00 UTC that touches model routing service. Marking as high-risk for this week's shifts.

kevin: Thanks deploy-bot — let's avoid scheduling any big runbook edits within 6 hours of that deploy. Olivia, can you target PR for Thu EOD?

olivia: Yes — aiming for Thu 3pm PT PR open for review. I'll add the compatibility checklist and token permission notes.

maria: Action items — Ben prepare 20m of slides + paste mitigation commands (including the rollback snippet) before Thu; Olivia PR by Thu 3pm; Natalie to shadow Thu 9am PT; Kevin to write brief note on model routing gotcha for runbook; I'll schedule the meeting and add recording + agenda. I'll post meeting invite and handoff checklist here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ben: I'll also include the exact Grafana panels to watch (latency, queue depth, model-inference-latency). Will post links.

natalie: Thanks everyone — appreciated. Looking forward to learning.

maria: Last note: after the shadow session we'll run a 15-min tabletop on escalation decision points (when to open a customer incident vs. when to just monitor). Put any scenarios you want covered in the meeting doc.

maria: (posted agenda + calendar invite) https://calendar.internal/meet/thu-shadow-9am - meeting created. Record/notes will go to handbook page: https://handbook.redwood/inference/oncall/shadowing

ben: Received invite. I'll post materials 1h before meeting.

kevin: Approved. If anything blocks, ping me.

oncall-bot: [REMINDER] Please ensure on-call contact info is up to date: https://hr.internal/oncall - auto reminders go out 24h before shift.

maria: Closing thread — we'll reconvene after Thu session for a short retro. If anyone wants to join earlier for prep, DM me.
